preconditions.description: The number of queries q must be between 1 and 10.
Each string a and b must have a length between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in a) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in b)
preconditions.description: Strings a and b must contain only lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(a) for a in queries) <= 2 * 10**5 and sum(len(b) for b in queries) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The total length of all strings a and b across queries must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(s_a + s_b == (s_a + s_b)[::-1] for s_a in substrings(a) for s_b in substrings(b)) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid palindromic string can be formed, output -1.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == max(len(s_a + s_b) for s_a in substrings(a) for s_b in substrings(b) if s_a + s_b == (s_a + s_b)[::-1])
postconditions.description: The output string must have the maximum length among all valid palindromic strings.

postconditions.expression: stdout == min(s_a + s_b for s_a in substrings(a) for s_b in substrings(b) if s_a + s_b == (s_a + s_b)[::-1] and len(s_a + s_b) == max_len)
postconditions.description: If multiple valid strings of maximum length exist, output the one that comes first alphabetically.
